transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hello, Dr. Smith. Nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because I've just... I've stopped wanting to do the things that usually keep me going. It's been pretty bad lately. I usually love going to salsa nights, heading to church gatherings, or cooking for my neighbors, but I just don't care about any of it right now. I'm a carpenter, and usually, I love just walking into my shop to enjoy the smell of the wood. But even that... I just have no interest in it anymore.
Have you ever experienced periods where your mood was unusually high, or you felt so energetic that you didn't need much sleep for days at a time?

Yeah, actually... at the beginning of all this, I did have stretches where I felt a lot like that. I just felt fired up, you know? Like I was almost unstoppable and could get anything done. 

But it wasn't exactly a great thing, because I was also really on edge. If my wife or one of the guys on my crew questioned me about anything, I would just snap at them over absolutely nothing. So, yeah, I had all that energy, but I was pretty quick to anger, too.
During those energetic periods, did your behavior become so extreme that it caused significant problems at work or required you to be hospitalized?

No, nothing like that. I've never been in the hospital for it or anything. And at work... well, like I said, I was pretty tough to be around because I kept snapping at my crew, but it didn't cause any major problems. I still ran the shop and got the jobs done on time. It was never so out of control that it ruined my business or put me in the hospital, no.
